column1: # Names for the links the book prints as a bare web address, since a URL is no name for a
# link (WCAG 2.4.9). One per line: the URL, a tab, then the link text, which has to read
# well where the URL sat ("See <name>.") and be unique on its page. convert.py warns about
# any bare URL left without a name. A name of "-" marks a made-up address in an example,
# which is shown as code instead of a link.
